mission_01: Congratulations! You have successfully applied PCA to reduce dimensionality from 5 to 2 components. You learned how to standardize data before PCA, fit the PCA model, and interpret the explained variance ratios. The cumulative explained variance tells you how much information is retained by the reduced representation. PCA is a foundational technique that you will use repeatedly for data exploration, visualization, and preprocessing. Always remember to standardize your data first, as PCA is sensitive to feature scales.
